Brand Color -- Configures the brand color shown in the app, available colors are: Blue, Green, Red, Orange. Defaults to Blue if not configured.
Brand Logo -- Configures the brand logo shown in the apps side menu. Specify a local path or Base64 string.
Support Page URL -- Configures the URL to open when the user clicks on the Get Support button.
Change Password URL -- Configures the URL to open when the user clicks on the Change Password button.
Change Password Mode -- Configures the mode for the Change Password button, available modes are: local, SSOExtension, url. Defaults to local if not configured.
Support Email -- Configures the email address shown when the user clicks on the Support Info button.
Support Phone -- Configures the phone number shown when the user clicks on the Support Info button.
Show Menu Toggle -- Configures whether to show the menu toggle button in the apps side menu.

Hidden Widgets -- Configures which widgets to hide, available widgets are: DeviceInfo, MunkiPendingApps, MunkiUpdates, IntunePendingApps, IntuneUpdates, Storage, MdmStatus, Actions, Battery, EvergreenInfo.
Hidden Actions -- Configures which actions to hide, available actions are: Support, ManagedSoftwareCenter, ChangePassword, Reboot, KillAgent, SoftwareUpdates, GatherLogs.
Notification Interval -- Configures the interval for notifications in hours for Application Updates and Software Updates notifications.
Notification Title -- Configures the title for notifications for notifications. Defaults to Support Companion if not configured.
Notification Image -- Configures an image to add to notifications. Local path should be specified.

Software Update Notification Message -- Configures the message for notifications for Software Updates notifications. Defaults to "You have software updates available. Take action now! \ud83c\udf89" if not configured.
Software Update Notification Button Text -- Configures the button text for notifications for Software Updates notifications. Defaults to "Details \ud83d\udc40" if not configured.

App Update Notification Message -- Configures the message for notifications for App Updates notifications. Defaults to "You have app updates available. Take action now! \ud83c\udf89" if not configured.
App Update Notification Button Text -- Configures the button text for notifications for App Updates notifications. Defaults to "Details \ud83d\udc40" if not configured.
Custom Colors -- Configures custom colors for the app, should be specified in hex format, see example below. Do not use BrandColor in conjunction with this key.

subkeys.description: Primary Color -- Configures the Primary Color for the app.
Accent Color -- Configures the Accent Color for the app.

keys.description: Intune Mode -- Configures the app to use Intune for application information. Only supports PKG and DMG type apps, not LOB.
System Profiler -- Configures the app to list all applications installed under /Applications and their versions. Useful if Munki or Intune is not used.
Log Folders -- Configures the log folders to gather logs from. Only used when gathering logs. Defaults to "/Library/Logs/Microsoft" if not configured.
Actions -- Configures custom actions to add to the tray menu. See example below.

subkeys.description: Name -- Name of the action to show in the menu.
Command -- Command to run when to item is clicked.
Icon -- Icon to show in the Self Service page in the UI.

keys.description: Show Desktop Info -- Configures the desktop info widget.
Desktop Position -- Configures the position of the desktop info. Defaults to TopRight.
Desktop Info Level -- Configures the level of information to show on the desktop. Defaults to Full.
Desktop Info Custom Items -- If DesktopInfoLevel is set to Custom, use this array to determine which information to show.
Desktop Info Background Color -- Configures the background color for the desktop info. Configure using Hex format. Defaults to Transparent
Desktop Info Background Opacity -- Configures the position of the desktop info. Defaults to 100%.
Desktop Info Color Highlight -- Configures whether to highlight the text in the desktop info. Defaults to true.
Desktop Info Font Size -- Configures the font size for the desktop info. Defaults to 17.
Custom Widgets Path -- Configures a path to a JSON file containing custom widgets to show on the Home view.

Log File -- jamJAR log file storage location. Prior to jamJAR 2.0: The log rotates at midnight & appends the date to the old file. As of jamJAR 2.0+: The log rotates every 10MB, not archiving older versions.
Log File Name -- jamJAR log file name.
Notification Message Title
Install Notification Message -- Notification message content when software is installed. Requires 2 string placeholders (%s), the first being the munki item name and the second being the version.
No Pending Installs Notification Message -- Notification message content when no software is pending.
Pending Installs Exist Notification Message -- Notification message content when software is pending.
Software Up-to-Date Notification Message -- Notification message content when software is up-to-date. Requires 1 string placeholder (%s), which defaults to the munki item name.

keys.default: macOS Updates available. Click here for more details
keys.description: OS Updates Pending Notification Message -- The notification text to display when macOS updates are pending. This leverages Manual Apple Updates in Munki 5
Notifying Application Path -- The path of the application sending jamJAR notifications. Only terminal-notifier & Jamf Pro's Management Action have been tested.

Notifying Application Bundle ID -- The bundle ID of the application that sent the notification, if using only terminal-notifier or Notifier, this should be /Applications/Managed Software Center.app (or whatever the path to MSC is, if using MSC).
dataJAR Notifier -- Determines if jamJAR should use the dataJAR notifier for notifications.
dataJAR Notifier Logout Button Title -- Sets the title for the logout button shown in the Alert notifications.
No Message Category -- Category name which when defined will not post a notification.
Delete Munki Secure Auth -- If set to True, deletes the AdditionalHttpHeaders key in /private/var/root/Library/Preferences/ManagedInstalls.plist
Login with SSO -- Default to login with SSO
SSO URL -- Set the default SSO URL for SSO login. If your Zoom login URL were myorg.zoom.us, the value for this preference would be 'myorg'.
Lock SSO URL -- Set and lock the default SSO URL for SSO login. If your Zoom login URL were myorg.zoom.us, the value for this preference would be 'myorg'.
Disable SSO Auto Launch -- Prevent Zoom from automatically launching the previously used SSO URL. This is useful for users with multiple accounts, each having their own SSO URL.
Disable Google Login -- Disable the Google login option
Disable Facebook Login -- Disable the Facebook login option
Enable Sign in with Apple -- Enable the Apple login option
Disable SSO Login -- Disable the SSO login option
Disable Email Login -- Remove Email login option
Disable Magic Code Login -- Users are prevented from signing in to their Zoom account with the one-time magic code option.
Disable Microsoft Login -- Disable login with Microsoft.

Disable Multiple Accounts Switch -- Disable the ability for users to be signed-in to multiple accounts and easily switch between them. If disabled, users must manually sign out and then sign in to another account.
Disable User SignUp -- Disable the Sign Up option on the Zoom app, which would otherwise be displayed with Join a Meeting and Sign In options upon opening the Zoom app.

Enable New Signin UI -- When a signed-out user opens the Zoom Workplace app, they will see the enhanced workplace interface with tabs that reflect Zoom products. Upon signing in, users will only see the products available to them.
Disable Facebook Keep Signed In -- Require new Facebook login every time Zoom launches.
Disable Google Keep Signed In -- Require new Google login every time Zoom launches.
Disable SSO Keep Signed In -- Require new SSO login every time Zoom launches.
Set Default Web Domain -- Sets the web domain for logging in or joining a meeting. By default, the value is https://zoom.us or https://zoom.com
Login Domain -- Set the email address domains that users can login with, each separated by '&'
Remember Last Login -- Remember the last login type used
Stay Signed In (Email) -- Client automatically logs in to the last email account used
Enable Automatic Updates -- Enable auto updates through the client
Update Channel -- Set the cadence of updates applied to the desktop client
Show Zoom Updates -- Show the Zoom Updates section of the General tab in client settings
Display Banner for Available Updates -- Show the Update Available banner on the Home tab of the client, when an update is available
Prompt for Updates on Leave -- Prompt users to update when exiting a meeting or webinar, when an update is available
Notify on Successful Update Install -- Show notification indicating an update has been successfully installed
Allow Manual Update Checks -- Control the visibility of the Check for Updates option in the client

Deploy Specific Zoom Version -- Download and install the specified version if the currently installed version is below that version. Format should be the official version without spaces or parentheses
Set Update Schedule Window -- Timeframe to download an available update version. Update is then initiated by the user through prompt, or during idle time or the specified safe upgrade period
Auto Install Updates When Idle -- Auto install an available update when the device is idle
Set Update Install Schedule Window -- Set to install updates within a given time period. Requires AU2_InstallAtIdleTime be enabled
Allow Manual Update Checks -- Allow users to check for updates through the Zoom client. If set to 'false', the 'Check for Updates' button is hidden.
Enable Silent Auto Updates -- Allows the Zoom client to silently check for available stable version updates. This option requires zAutoUpdate option to be enabled, and will fail if not enabled.
Allow Zoom to Check for Updates Automatically -- Allows the desktop client to check for any available updates. This option requires zAutoUpdate option to be enabled, and will fail if not enabled.
Enable Cloud Switch -- Enable the option to switch between Zoom commercial (default) and Zoom for Gov.
Enable Embedded Zoom Browser for SSO -- Use the embedded browser in the Zoom client for SSO.
Enable Phone Login -- Enables login with phone authentication.
Enable Alipay Login -- Enables login with Alipay authentication.
Enable QQ Login -- Enables login with QQ authentication.
Enable WeChat Login -- Enables login with WeChat authentication.
Force Sign In To Join Meetings -- Force users to be signed in with a Zoom account before joining a meeting. Users can be signed-in on the web portal when joining via a join URL.
Force Sign In To Join Webinars -- Force users to be signed in with a Zoom account before joining a webinar. Users can be signed-in on the web portal when joining via a join URL.
Force App Sign In To Join Meetings -- Force users to be signed in with a Zoom account in the app before joining any meeting or webinar.
Force App Sign In To Join Webinars -- Force users to be signed in with a Zoom account in the app before joining any webinar.

Disable Zoom Helper Daemon Install -- Controls the use of the daemon helper to install updates, which bypasses the need to enter admin credentials when upgrading. This option requires AutoUpdate option to be enabled, and will fail if not enabled.
ZMDM Enrollment Token -- Auto enroll devices to Zoom MDM with a token provided from the Zoom web portal.
Default to Portrait Mode -- Default to Portrait Mode upon opening Zoom
Disable Direct Share -- Disables direct share with Zoom Rooms
Present to Zoom Room in Meeting Default Option -- Set default sharing option when sharing directly to a Zoom Room within a meeting.
Present to Zoom Room Default Option -- Set the default sharing option when sharing directly to a Zoom Room.
Present to Zoom Room with Audio -- Share sound when screen sharing to a Zoom Room
Present to Zoom Room with Optimized Video -- If enabled, will optimize screen sharing for video clip when sharing directly to a Zoom Room.
Enable HID Control -- Enables HID control of USB audio devices from the Zoom client
Enable Start Meeting with Room System Button -- Displays the 'Call Room System' button on the home screen of the Zoom client
Always Show Video Preview Dialog -- If enabled, always show the video preview when joining a meeting.
Ignore Bandwidth Limits -- Ignore bandwidth limited set on web settings.
Legacy Capture Mode -- If enabled, disables GPU acceleration.
Block Untrusted SSL Certs -- Block connections to untrusted SSL certificates.
Disable Certificate Pinning
Disable Audio Over Proxy -- Prevent audio traffic over proxies.
Disable Direct Connection to Web -- Disable all direct connections to Zoom web service.
Disable Sharing Over Proxy -- Prevent sharing traffic over proxies.
Disable Video Over Proxy -- Prevent video traffic over proxies.
Embed User Agent String -- Embed a specified user agent string for all HTTP requests from the Zoom client.
Embed Device Tag -- Embed a specified device tag string for all HTTP requests from Zoom client application. This string will be appended to the head of the regular HTTP requests.
Disable Zoom Apps -- If enabled, hides the Zoom Apps quick launch button in the Zoom interface.
Disable Zoom Apps Guest Access -- Control the ability for users to utilize a Zoom App in Guest mode.
Restrict Meetings to Specified Host Account ID -- Restrict the Zoom client to join meetings from the specified account IDs.

subkeys.description: Account ID

keys.description: Device Policy Token -- Enforce internal meeting authentication.
Disable Camera by Default -- Automatically turn off camera when joining a meeting
Disable Sending Video -- Disable sending video from the Zoom Client
Disable Receiving Video -- Disable receiving video from the Zoom Client
Disable Computer Audio -- Disable use of computer audio on the Zoom Client
Enable Original Sound -- Enable Orginal Sound for audio
Automatically Join -- Automatically join VoIP
Auto Adjust Microphone -- Automatically adjust microphone levels
Enable 49 Participant Gallery View -- Sets the max number of participants displayed in Gallery View to 49 participants per screen
Hide Self View -- Controls the use of the Hide Self View option
Touch Up Appearance -- Enables the 'Touch Up' appearance setting
Touch Up Appearence Intensity -- Allows setting the exact intensity of the Touch up my appearance filter
Enable Echo Cancellation -- Enables echo cancellation for the microphone audio
Enable Hardware Optimized Video Sharing -- Enable to require hardware acceleration to optimize video sharing
Set Background Noise Suppression Level -- Set the noise suppression level
Set Screen Capture Mode -- Forces the specified screen capture mode
Use System Default for Computer Audio -- Uses the system default speaker when using computer audio
Use System Default for Computer Microphone -- Uses the system default speaker when using microphone audio
Auto Enable Dual Monitor -- Automatically enable dual monitor
Auto Full Screen When Viewing -- Automatically enter full screen when viewing shared content
Auto Fit to Window When Viewing -- Automatically fit to window when viewing shared content
Disable Annotation -- Disable and remove the ability to annotate over shared screen
Enable Split Screen -- Enables side-by-side mode by default
Enable Spotlight Self -- If enabled, shows self as the active speaker when speaking
Enable Full Screen on Meeting Join -- Full Screen when starting or joining a meeting
Hide Incoming Calls in Meetings -- If enabled, prevents incoming call notifications while in a meeting
Enable Launch App for Incoming Calls -- Control the Launch an external app or a URL for incoming calls option in the client
Set Command for Incoming Calls -- Set the URL used when the client receives an incoming call
Auto Hide Meeting Controls -- If set to 'false', always show meeting controls (enables the always show meeting control setting).
Default to HD Video -- Enable HD video in meetings
Enable Full Remote Control -- Remote control all applications
Hide Non-Video Participants -- Hide non-video participants by default
Disable Microphone on Meeting Join -- Always mute microphone when joining a meeting
Show Meeting Attendance Length -- Show the length of time that the user has been in a meeting
Mute Microphone When Lock Screen Enabled -- Automatically mute the microphone and turn off video, when the screen is locked during a meeting.
Prompt User When Leaving Meeting -- Confirm before leaving a meeting
Auto Disable Screen Sharing -- Disable Screen Share when starting or joining a meeting
Enable Audio Sharing -- Enable the Share computer audio option when sharing
Enable Video Sharing Optimization -- Enable the Optimize for video clip option when sharing
Disable Whiteboard -- Disable Classic Whiteboard feature
Disable Meeting / Webinar Whiteboard -- Disable the Zoom Whiteboard feature in meetings and webinars
Disable Desktop Sharing -- Disable the option to share your desktop when screen sharing
Disable Slide Control -- Disable the use of slide control
Disable Remote Control During Screen Sharing -- Disables Remote Control when screen sharing
Enable Do Not Disturb in Desktop Sharing -- Silence system notifications when sharing desktop
Disable 1:1 Remote Support During Screen Sharing -- Disables 1:1 remote support when screen sharing
Enable Video Mirroring -- Enable mirroring of shared video
Disable Local Recording -- Disables Local Recording from the Zoom Client
Disable Cloud Recording -- Disables Cloud Recording from the Zoom Client
Disable Chat -- Disable in-meeting chat
Disable File Transfer -- Disables in-metting file transfer (sharing and receiving)
Disable Meeting Third Party File Storage -- Disable in-meeting 3rd party file transfer
Disable Webinar Q&A -- Disable Q&A in webinars
Disable Virtual Background -- Disables use of the Virtual Background feature
Disable Meeting Reactions -- Disables use of reactions in meetings
Disable Non-Verbal Feedback -- Disable the use of non-verbal feedback.
Disable Webinar Recations -- Disable the use of Webinar reactions.
Disable Broadcast Messaging -- Disable the ability for the host to broadcast a message to all open breakout rooms.
Enable Auto Reverse of Virtual Background -- Require post-meeting virtual background auto-reversal.
Disable Video Filters -- Disables use of video filters
Enable Split Port Traffic -- Split traffic across different ports for easier identification
Enable Light Adaption -- Set use of adjust for low-light video setting
Enable Auto Light Adaption -- Set method of adjusting low-light video feature
Set Light Adaption Value -- Set method of adjusting low-light video feature
Video Render Method -- Set the video rendering method
Enable Meeting Reminder -- If enabled, sets a reminder for upcoming meetings
SSL Verification -- The Zoom Client will verify the server certificate
Enable Shared Clipboard in Remote Control -- Allow clipboard access during remote control sessions
Disable Closed Captioning -- Prevent the use of closed captioning
Disable Manual Closed Captioning -- Prevent the use of manual, user-entered closed captioning
Maximum Bandwidth -- Limit the Maximum amount of bandwidth by the Mac client
Minimum Bandwidth -- Limit the Minimum amount of bandwidth used by the Mac client
Local Recording Path -- Set path for local meeting recording files
Proxy Bypass Rule -- Set proxy bypass rule for the Zoom Client
Proxy Server -- Set the proxy server for the Zoom Client
Proxy PAC -- Set proxy server to client with PAC URL for the Zoom Client
Disable Link Preview in Chat -- Disable Link Preview
New Replies on Bottom -- Move messages with new replies to the bottom of the chat/channel
Show Profile Photos in Chat -- Controls if user profile pictures are shown in Zoom Chat
Mute Chat Notifications When in a Meeting -- Control if IM message system notifications are muted when in a meeting
Play Notification Sound for Chat Messages -- Control the audio notifications when an IM message is received
Show Chat Message Previews -- Control if the message previews in system notifications when an IM message is received
Display the Voice Message Button -- If enabled, shows the send voice message button
Display the Video Message Button -- Allow use of the Send video message option
Override Enforce Sign In (ZfG) -- Override the EnforceSignInToJoin policy and allows a user to join a Zoom meeting hosted on the ZfG Cloud, without the need to authenticate
Disable All Features (ZfG) -- Disables all features except for audio and video for meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Meeting Chat (ZfG) -- Disables the use of in-meeting chat on meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Screen Sharing (ZfG) -- Disables the local ability to share screen on meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Meeting Reactions (ZfG) -- Disables the use of meeting reactions on meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Meeting File Transfer (ZfG) -- Disables the use of file transfers through in-meeting chat on meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Annotations (ZfG) -- Disables the local ability to annotate on shared content in meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Whiteboard (ZfG) -- Disables the use of in-meeting whiteboarding on meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Local Recording (ZfG) -- Disabled by default, this option disables the ability to locally record meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Closed Captioning (ZfG) -- Disabled by default, this option disables the use of captioning features on meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Remote Control (ZfG) -- Disabled by default, this option disables the remote control of shared screens in meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Meeting Polls (ZfG) -- Disabled by default, this option disables the use of polling in meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud
Disable Computer Audio (ZfG) -- Disabled by default, this option disables the use of computer audio for connecting to meetings hosted on the ZfG Cloud

entries.name: xyz.techitout.appAutoPatch
entries.title: App Auto-Patch
entries.description: This will configure the settings for the App Auto-Patch tool

keys.description: Days Until Reset -- The number of days after the patching cadence start date (Zero Date) that the patching complete status will reset from TRUE to FALSE
Patch Week Start Day -- The day of the week to force the patching cadence start date (Zero Date) to go back to in order to have the patch cadence start the same day of the week for all users
Focus Count Deadline -- The maximum number of automatic deferrals allowed if the system is in user-enabled Focus/Do Not Disturb or when a process has requested that the display not go to sleep
Hard Count Deadline -- The maximum number of user selected deferrals allowed before App Auto-Patch will no longer allow deferrals and will automatically patch when the timer expires

Focus Days Deadline -- The maximum number of days that automatic deferrals are allowed if the system is in user-enabled Focus/Do Not Disturb or when a process has requested that the display not go to sleep
Hard Days Deadline -- The maximum number of days deferrals allowed before App Auto-Patch will no longer allow deferrals and will automatically patch when the timer expires
Deferral Timer Default -- The number of minutes to defer until the next update workflow attempt if a user choses not install updates
Deferral Timer Error -- The number of minutes to defer if AAP detects an error in the workflow

Deferral Timer Focus -- The number of minutes to defer the update restart dialog automatically if a process has prevented display sleep (for example, during an active meeting) or the user has Focus or Do Not Disturb enabled
Deferral Timer Menu -- Display a deferral time pop-up menu in the non-deadline install dialog that allows the user to override the Deferral Timer Default timer

Deferral Timer Workflow Relaunch -- Amount of time in minutes until AAP is relaunched after a workflow. This timer results in AAP acting as a permanent agent that checks for app updates on a regular basis
Monthly Patching Cadence Enabled
Monthly Patching Cadence Ordinal Value -- Week of the month you want AAP to be scheduled
Monthly Patching Cadence Weekday Index -- Day of the week you want AAP to be scheduled
Monthly Patching Cadence Start Time -- Local time you want AAP to be scheduled
Discovery Frequency -- The number of hours since the last successful App Discovery before App Auto-Patch will run discovery again.
Zoom Call Active Check -- When enabled, AAP will automatically skip updating Zoom if a call is active

allowedValueTitles: Do Not Force Dialog On Top
keys.description: Dialog On Top -- Forces the AAP dialogs to stay on top of all other windows

Show Dock Icon -- When true, workflow swiftDialog windows show the App Auto-Patch logo in the macOS Dock (requires swiftDialog 3.0+). Deferral dialogs badge the pending update count; the installation dialog counts the badge down as updates finish. Default true.

allowedValueTitles: STOP — stop until next scheduled run
keys.description: Discovery/Staging Dialog Quit Handling -- What happens if the user quits the discovery or staging window (Dock Quit / menu Quit / ⌘Q). PROMPT (default) asks whether to Keep Running in the background or Stop App Auto-Patch until the next scheduled run.
Show Notifications (All) -- Master switch for banner-style swiftDialog notifications. When true (default), every notification type is shown and individual ShowNotifications* keys are ignored.

Show Notification: Silent Updated -- When ShowNotificationsAll is false, enable the banner that reports successful silent closed-app updates (e.g. “updated {count} application(s) in the background”). Ignored when ShowNotificationsAll is true.

Show Notification: Apps Queued -- When ShowNotificationsAll is false, enable the banner that reports pending updates with Install Now / Dismiss (including after BusinessHoursAllowDiscovery). Ignored when ShowNotificationsAll is true.

Show Notification: Silent And Queued -- When ShowNotificationsAll is false, enable the combined banner after Business Hours Silent During (“{count} updated… {remaining} remain queued”). Ignored when ShowNotificationsAll is true.
Deferral Dialog Timeout -- Time given to the user to respond to deferral prompt if enabled
Deferral Dialog Timeout Action -- What happens when the deferral timer expires

Confirm Install Dialog Timeout -- The number of seconds given to the user to respond to the "Are you sure?" confirmation dialog shown after clicking Install Now on the deferral dialog. If the timer expires with no response, App Auto-Patch defaults to continuing with the install
Unattended Exit -- Deterines if the Dialog should automatically close after completion if there is no response from the end-user
Unattended Exit Seconds -- The number of seconds the AAP dialog will automatically close if UnattendedExit is set to TRUE
Use Overlay Icon -- Toggles swiftDialog to use an overlay icon
Dialog Icon -- Allows you to set a custom icon for the dialog vs. the default Laptop/Desktop symbol
Banner Image -- Displays a swiftDialog banner image in place of the standard title text. Accepts a filepath, a URL, a solid colour (colour=#hex), or a gradient (gradient=colour,colour).
Banner Title -- The text displayed within the banner image set by BannerImage. Falls back to AppTitle if left blank. Has no effect unless BannerImage is also configured
Banner Height -- Overrides the default height, in points, of the banner image set by BannerImage. Invalid (non-integer) values are ignored. Has no effect unless BannerImage is also configured

Ignored Labels -- A space-separated list of Installomator labels to ignore for the AAP workflow. Supports wildcards, for example "microsoft*". A single "*" ignores every Installomator label except those listed in Required Labels and Optional Labels.

Excluded Background Labels -- A space-separated list of Installomator labels to discover and report, but not update during fully-silent runs (InteractiveMode 0 / --workflow-install-now-silent) or Background Patch Closed Apps.
Required Labels -- a space-separated list of Installomator labels that are required, regardless if the app is installed or or the latest version. Supports wildcards.

Optional Labels -- A space-separated list of optional Installomator labels. Labels in this category are only included if the app exists on the end-users device and will force install even if its the latest version. Does Not Support Wildcards
App Title -- Allows you to customize the name of App Auto-Patch to something else
Convert Apps In Home Folder -- This will convert any apps found in the users home folder to the /Applications folder

allowedValueTitles: Move Apps to the Default Path
keys.description: Ignore Apps In Home Folder -- Ignore apps found in '/Users/'. If an update is found in '/Users/' and variable is set to false, the app will be updated into the application's default path

Skip Pre-Update Verification -- When true, discovery skips the local Gatekeeper (spctl) / Team ID pre-update check for already-installed apps. Use this when spctl assessment intermittently fails for a valid app and would otherwise exclude it from discovery/updates.
Installomator Options -- A space-separated list of options to override default Installomator options (i.e., BLOCKING_PROCESS_ACTION=prompt_user NOTIFY=silent LOGO=appstore)

Installomator Update Disable -- This will prevent Installomator from automatically updating. If Installomator does not exist in the working folder, it will still download from GitHub to prevent script failure

GitHub API Auth Enabled -- When TRUE, App Auto-Patch authenticates GitHub REST API requests (api.github.com) with the personal access token in GitHubAPIToken, raising the rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests per hour.

GitHub API Token -- GitHub personal access token (classic or fine-grained) used when GitHubAPIAuthEnabled is TRUE. Sent as Authorization: Bearer on api.github.com requests for Installomator and swiftDialog lookups.

Pre Patch Script -- Absolute path to a root-owned executable script run once before Installomator installations in a patch run. Must live under /Library/Management/AppAutoPatch/Hooks/, must not be a symlink, and must not be group/world-writable.

Post Patch Script -- Absolute path to a root-owned executable script run once after Installomator installations complete in a patch run (for example jamf recon). Same security requirements as PrePatchScript. Managed preferences only.
Pre Patch Script Fail Action -- What to do if PrePatchScript is missing/invalid or exits non-zero. ABORT stops the install run; CONTINUE logs the failure and proceeds with patching.

Post Patch Script Fail Action -- What to do if PostPatchScript is missing/invalid or exits non-zero. ABORT exits AAP with an error after installs; CONTINUE (default) logs the failure and proceeds with webhook/relaunch.
Patch Script Timeout Seconds -- Maximum seconds allowed for a PrePatchScript or PostPatchScript run before AAP terminates it (treated as failure).

Stale Process Timeout Seconds -- Seconds of missing heartbeat after which a leftover App Auto-Patch process is treated as hung and recovered (graceful TERM, then KILL if needed). The PID file is also validated so a recycled PID is not mistaken for a live AAP run.

Installomator Version -- Determines if the AAP script should use the Main, Release, or Custom version of Installomator. The version from the Main branch typically includes more recent updates from PR's to fix issues or add new labels.

Installomator Version custom Repo Path -- If InstallomatorVersion is set to Custom, enter the Github Site and Repository name in the following format: site_name/repo_name . For example, if the custom fork is located at https://github.com/TechTrekkie/Installomator, you would set this key to…
Installomator Version Custom Branch Name -- The name of the branch you want to use in your custom repo, typically main.
Interactive Mode -- 0 (Completely Silent) | 1 (Silent Discovery, Interactive Patching) | 2 (Full Interactive) (default)
Remove Installomator Path -- Remove Installomator after App Auto-Patch is completed
Support Team Name -- For the Support Team details that display in the Help Message
Support Team Email -- For the Support Team details that display in the Help Message
Support Team Phone -- For the Support Team details that display in the Help Message
Support Team Website -- For the Support Team details that display in the Help Message
Webhook Feature -- Determines if Webhooks are sent when patching is completed
Slack Webhook URL -- The Slack Webhook URL to use if WebhookFeature is set to TRUE
Teams Webhook URL -- The Teams Webhook URL to use if WebhookFeature is set to TRUE

Google Chat Webhook URL -- The Google Chat incoming webhook URL to use if WebhookFeature is set to ALL or FAILURES. The card includes the same status, serial, user, labels, errors, and MDM device link as the Slack and Teams webhooks.

Mosyle Console URL -- Override the Mosyle admin console host used in Slack/Teams "View in Mosyle" device links. The enrollment ServerURL (for example https://biz-1234.mosyle.com) is the MDM check-in endpoint, not the console.
Disable App Discovery Workflow -- Disables the discovery of applications that require patching. If a list of labels from a previous discovery exists, AAP will use that list for the workflow
Background Patch Closed Apps -- When InteractiveMode is 1 or 2, silently pre-patches apps that are not currently open immediately after discovery and before any deferral/deadline dialog is shown.

Stage Updates -- Pre-downloads (stages) installers for queued updates to a local staging folder immediately after discovery, before the deferral/deadline dialog is shown to the user. This makes the later install step nearly instantaneous for staged updates.

Ignore Do Not Disturb Apps -- A comma-separated list of app/process names to exclude from display-sleep assertion (Focus/Do Not Disturb) detection. Useful for background utilities that permanently hold display assertions (e.g.
Scheduled Discovery Only -- When WorkflowDisableRelaunch is also enabled, keep periodic headless discovery runs active using DiscoveryFrequency.
Disable Relaunch Workflow -- Disable the automatic relaunch of AAP after the current workflow successfully completes
Business Hours -- Weekday time windows when interactive App Auto-Patch must NOT run (blocked / do-not-disturb hours). Format: DAY:hh:mm-hh:mm, comma-separated, no spaces (MON-SUN, 24-hour).

Business Hours Respect Hard Deadline -- When true, even an overdue hard deadline (days or count) waits until BusinessHours clear. When false (default), an overdue hard deadline bypasses BusinessHours so mandatory installs are not delayed by days.

Business Hours Silent During -- When true and during BusinessHours, AAP still runs discovery and silently patches closed apps only — no dialogs even if InteractiveMode is 1 or 2. Open or blocked apps remain queued and are deferred until BusinessHours clear.

Business Hours Allow Discovery -- When true and during BusinessHours without BusinessHoursSilentDuring, AAP runs discovery then defers until the window clears (no interactive dialogs or silent patching).
Workflow Install Now Patching Status Action -- Determines if the Patching Completion Status is set to true when using the --workflow-install-now trigger
Self Update Enabled -- Determines if the Self Update feature is enabled. this will automatically update App Auto-Patch if a new version is posted on github
Self Update Frequency -- The frequency to check for updates to the App Auto-Patch script
Version Comparison Method -- Determines the version comparison method used when checking for updates
Version Comparison Installomator Fallback -- When enabled, if version comparison fails, AAP will fall back to using Installomator for version checking
User Interface -- All features related to how App Auto Patch defines the user interface.
